description.fun: A round, mirror-bright metal bull with axe-like horns that store laser-like energy, letting it plough through anything in its path. A paranormal magazine claimed it was an ordinary Terrakion modified by an evil organisation. Its horns can turn into blades shaped like pointed spades, and when it sleeps its orange glow goes dark.
description.guide: A Rock and Psychic-type Paradox Pokémon introduced in The Indigo Disk, said to be either a future relative of Terrakion or a version of it from a parallel timeline. Its axe-like horns store energy that lets it cut through obstacles. Its counterpart is Gouging Fire.
description.tagline: A mirror-metal Terrakion with laser-charged axe horns
